فُرُجٌ (S, O, K) and ↓ فِرْجٌ , with kesr, (O,) or ↓ فُرْجٌ , (K,) and ↓ فَارِجٌ and ↓ فَرِيجٌ , (S, O, K,) [like فَرُوجٌ (see 7) and فَجَّآءُ,] A bow wide apart from the string; (S, O, K;) or of which the string is distant from its كَبِد [q. v.]. (TA.) ―
-b2- And the first, A woman wearing a single garment; (O, L, K;) of the dial. of El-Yemen; (O, L;) like فُضُلٌ in the dial. of Nejd; (L;) as also ↓ فُرْجٌ . (K.) ―
-b3- And, as also ↓ فِرْجٌ , One who will not conceal a secret: (O, K:) and ↓ فُرَجَةٌ a man wont to reveal his secrets. (Ham p. 49.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
